title: DHMI-WHO-EUR: Reproducibility package for the Digital Health Maturity Index
description:
Reproducibility package supporting the paper Benchmarking Digital Health Governance in the WHO European Region: A Composite Maturity Index for Cross-Country Policy Comparison by Curiello, Iannuzzi & Nigro (2026, Benchmarking: An International Journal).

The package contains the complete R pipeline for constructing the Digital Health Maturity Index (DHMI), a composite benchmarking instrument that quantifies national digital health governance maturity across the 53 Member States of the WHO European Region using 74 WHO-standardised policy indicators. Components include: the raw WHO 2023 Regional Office for Europe survey data; the R scripts implementing the four-procedure robustness protocol (weight perturbation across 1,000 simulations, PCA-derived weighting, missing-data sensitivity analysis, external validity testing against DESI and the WHO UHC Service Coverage Index); the k-means cluster analysis with silhouette and Dunn-index validation; the Spearman correlation analysis with Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction across 903 indicator pairs; the LASSO regression with 10-fold and leave-one-out cross-validation; and the Mann-Whitney U tests with FDR correction.

Two licences apply: the source code is released under the MIT License; the author-produced data products are released under CC BY 4.0. The raw WHO survey data are redistributed under the World Health Organization open data licensing terms.
